description: This file defines an interface for a client addressable test client object in the Orleans testing framework, including several asynchronous methods for stress testing and message handling.

methods.name: OnHappyPath
methods.description: Handles a happy path message and returns a string result asynchronously.

methods.name: OnSadPath
methods.description: Handles a sad path message asynchronously.

methods.name: OnSerialStress
methods.description: Performs serial stress testing with an integer parameter, returns an integer asynchronously.

methods.name: OnParallelStress
methods.description: Performs parallel stress testing with an integer parameter, returns an integer asynchronously.
